p11r2c: Whichever age it picks on, saving everybody was never your job. At fifteen you probably didn't even have your own money, or anywhere else to go. Every age of you was stuck with whatever it had then, and that includes the adult you were last year, even if they seem like the one who should have known better. You still did what you did, though, and if it hurt people or damaged a life, that may need repair.
p11r2b: Whichever age it goes after, saving everybody was never that age's job, and it isn't your job now either. Each age of you could only work with what you had then, and at fifteen that was mostly what your own family had shown you and whoever happened to be around. That's about the accusation, though. What you actually did could still have hurt people or damaged a life, and some of it may need repair.
